text:
alex_goodman: Heads up — I kicked off the staggered regional warmup for v2.1.3-rc3. Starting US -> EU -> APAC. Please monitor capacity and pin fallback variants if things look noisy.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed for US (slice=10%, warmup=5m). GPU pool available: 24/30. Routing policy: latency-first.

mira_k: Thanks. Can ops confirm KV-cache hit rates for the US slices? We want prefix caching enabled before EU.

samira: US KV hit ~82% on the smoke run. Latency p50 38ms p95 110ms. No OOMs.

ops_lead_tom: Noted. I'm holding EU warmup until we confirm US sustained throughput for 10m. Also bumping EU min-gpu threshold from 6 -> 8 to be safe.

alex_goodman: Good call. Pin rule: if p95 > 180ms or error-rate > 0.4% for 3min, rollback to v2.1.2 and pin EU/US to that variant.

deploy-bot: EU preflight check queued. Command used:```sh
./infra/deployctl preflight --region eu --model v2.1.3-rc3 --min-gpu 8 --warmup 5m
```

mira_k: Running that now. Also enabling automatic KV-prefetch for frequent prompts set (promptset: onboarding_flow).

deploy-bot: EU preflight: GPU pool 9/10 available, KV cache primed, smoke latency p95 172ms, error-rate 0.12%. Ready for slice.

june_p: APAC capacity check FYI — scheduled maintenance window in ap-southeast-1 at 03:00 local, so we'll postpone APAC ramp by 40m.

samira: Noted. We'll keep APAC at 0% until the window clears. Can we reserve burst capacity post-maintenance?

ops_lead_tom: Yes — we have a warm pool reservation. Plan: APAC slice start at t+40m with initial 5% and heat to 15% over 20m. If thermal alarms occur, fallback to EU-hosted replicas for dev tier only.

alex_goodman: Release notes snippet for this rollout (for on-call and support):
- model: v2.1.3-rc3 (main improvements: kernel selection perf, kv cache improvements)
- staged rollout: US -> EU -> APAC (delayed)
- rollback triggers: p95>180ms OR errors>0.4% sustained 3m
- pin fallback: v2.1.2

mira_k: quick sanity: can someone paste the deploy-bot command for manual rollback?

deploy-bot: Manual rollback command:```sh
./infra/deployctl rollback --region $REGION --to v2.1.2 --reason "auto/ops-trigger" --force-if-unhealthy
```

samira: If we need to pin across regions quickly use the orchestration API: POST /rollouts/pin {regions:["us","eu","apac"], version:"v2.1.2", reason:"emergency"} (auth: ops svc token).

ops_lead_tom: Small follow-up: I'm enabling a temporary routing policy that will send VIP traffic to dedicated-capacity nodes during the warmup in US/EU to reduce noisy-neighbor risk.

alex_goodman: Perfect. I'll update the console notes and post the short release banner in #general once EU hits 20% and holds for 10m.

mira_k: Observability checklist: set token-cost alert at +30% baseline, set quality-regression eval bucket, and add slack hook to this thread for any errors tagged "deploy: rollback-signal".

deploy-bot: US slice at 10% -> stable for 12m. No degradation. EU slice ramping to 20% now. APAC still delayed.

samira: thumbs up from me. If EU p95 creeps >160ms in the next 5m we should preemptively reduce EU to 15% before it hits trigger.

alex_goodman: Agreed. Ops, please reduce to 15% on that signal.

ops_lead_tom: Copy — will reduce to 15% if p95>160ms for 2m.

deploy-bot: EU slice at 20% -> p95 178ms for last 2m, error-rate 0.22%. Monitoring.

mira_k: Reducing EU to 15% now manually — doing ```./infra/deployctl scale --region eu --percent 15```.

deploy-bot: EU scaled to 15%. p95 dropped to 150ms. Holding.

june_p: Update: APAC maintenance finished early, warm-pool still available. Recommend starting APAC at 5% in 10m.

alex_goodman: Let's hold 10m. If all stable, start APAC at 5% then heat to 15% over 20m. Reminder: if any region hits rollback trigger, we do full pin to v2.1.2 across regions.

samira: I'll post the rollback playbook in the incident doc and link here.

alex_goodman: Thanks everyone — great coordination. I'll close the thread when APAC reaches 15% steady for 10m. :white_check_mark:
